item.title: Correction · Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons (interim, west): The map notes said the shape traces only the Parklab Gardens sub-area; it is OpenStreetMap's whole 'Parklab' park strip (about 14,665 sq m), which contains both the Parklab Gardens and Spark Social SF areas, and it is tagged as a park, not a garden. The notes also said P15's concept matches Spark Social SF's use of that parcel; OCII's Nov 2024 CAC update puts Spark Social SF and the community garden on P13 and Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens on P15, and the Workshop 3 deck dates interim-use pilots to P13 (2016), P15 (2017) and P12 (2018). The claim that a design team was selected through an August 2025 RFQ now says what SF Rec & Park reports: an RFQ was released and a team was expected by mid-October. The 'early 2030' opening milestone is relabelled as a whole-project estimate, with a note that Workshop 3 shows an earlier construction window. The map notes carry a dated correction, and the shape's notes and source description were corrected.

item.title: Added · Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons (interim, west): SF Rec & Park's three community-workshop decks were added as sources for the interim parcels P12, P13 and P15 (OCII's Nov 2024 CAC update labels P13 as Community Garden & SPARK Social SF, P15 as Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens and P12 as the SFF Soccer + Fitness Court), each checked against the PDF itself. Community Meeting #3 (Apr 29, 2025, 83 pages) has individually labeled concept-plan pages for P12, P13 and P15 (food trucks, outdoor dining and a pavilion on P15; soccer pitches and outdoor fitness on P12), plus an alternative option for P12. These are design-workshop concepts, not an adopted final plan: SF Rec & Park's Future Parks page later reported (August 2025) that a design-team RFQ had been released and a team was expected to be selected by mid-October; no selection is reported there.

item.title: Existing · Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons (interim, west): Parklab Gardens (one interim installation inside the mapped Parklab park strip; OCII's Nov 2024 map puts it on P15) opens, per SF Chronicle coverage pairing its opening with Stagecoach Greens mini-golf. Interim-use pilots on the Commons parcels began on P13 in 2016, P15 in 2017 and P12 in 2018 (SF Rec & Park Workshop 3 deck, p.15). (~2018)
item.description: Parklab Gardens (one interim installation inside the mapped Parklab park strip; OCII's Nov 2024 map puts it on P15) opens, per SF Chronicle coverage pairing its opening with Stagecoach Greens mini-golf. Interim-use pilots on the Commons parcels began on P13 in 2016, P15 in 2017 and P12 in 2018 (SF Rec & Park Workshop 3 deck, p.15). (~2018). Source: SF Chronicle, "Outdoor mini golf right here in SF? Yes, and with food trucks and a beer garden" (Aug 2018); https://sfrecpark.org/DocumentCenter/View/25986/20250429-PRESENTATION-Workshop-3.

item.title: Existing · Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons (interim, west): Spark Social SF, one of the interim uses on these parcels, launches at 601 Mission Bay Blvd. North (Parklab's project page: 'launch date: May 2016'). The page covers Spark Social only; the soccer fields, garden and mini golf are not dated in any source read (May 2016)
